# Plasma Bot

> Temporary QSR plasma fusing service for the Zenon Network

Plasma Bot lets any Zenon address receive temporary plasma by fusing QSR from a shared wallet. Plasma is the fee/gas mechanism on Zenon — fusing QSR to an address grants it plasma for sending transactions without burning tokens. Fusions are temporary and automatically reclaimed after ~21 hours.

## API

Base URL: https://plazma.bot

### Request a fusion

POST /api/agent/fuse
Content-Type: application/json

Request body:
{
  "address": "z1qzal6c5s9rjnnxd2z7dvdhjxpmmj4fmw56a0mz",
  "tier": "low"
}

Tiers: low (20 QSR), medium (80 QSR), high (120 QSR)

Success response (200):
{
  "success": true,
  "txHash": "abc123...",
  "address": "z1q...",
  "tier": "low",
  "amount": 20
}

Error codes: VALIDATION_FAILED (400), RATE_LIMITED (429), ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE (429), INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE (503), FUSE_FAILED (500)

### Check availability

GET /api/stats

Returns wallet balance, available tiers, and active fusion count.

### Check fusion status

GET /api/fusions/{address}

Returns fusion history for a specific address.

### Health check

GET /api/health

## Constraints

- Rate limit: 10 requests per IP per 24 hours
- One active fusion per address at a time
- Fusions are temporary (~21 hours) and automatically reclaimed

## Machine-readable spec

OpenAPI 3.0: https://plazma.bot/api/openapi.json
